{{Quote|If anyone finds this, please tell Jeridel of my fate. I am Jenson, lead creature handler for this lab. Something has gone wrong, and the creatures are loose. The Engineered Acklay attacked me when I tried to feed it, and since then, I have been slowly bleeding to death down here.|Jenson's final datapad entry|<ref name="SWG:MB" />}}
'''Jenson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Jenson was the brother of [[Jeridel]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], both worked in an [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|illegal lab]] on Corellia,<ref name="SWG:MB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Missing Brother|Corellia}}</ref> a lab specialized in [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineering]] creatures through dangerous genetic experiments.<ref name="SWG:CMAoD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jenson was promoted as lead creature handler. However, when he attempted to feed an engineered [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], it attacked, leaving him bleeding to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Before he died, he left a message on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] for Jeridel. Three days later,<ref name="SWG:MB" /> a spacer working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] arrived to investigate the lab,<ref name="SWG:CMAS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Administrative Secrets|Corellia}}</ref> Jeridel hired the spacer to search the laboratory to find out what had happened to Jenson. The spacer later returned and informed Jeridel that Jenson had been killed by the acklay.<ref name="SWG:MB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jenson's skeletal remains appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jenson was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>

Jenson's [[Species/Legends|species]] was never identified, and as Jeridel's species was randomly generated, it is impossible to deduce the species from their biological relation. However, Jenson was some sort of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species.<ref name="SWG:MB" />
